Shaved Ice with Festive Red and Green Syrups

Served at: Tiki Christmas at Pearl Harbor

Serves 4-6Prep 25 minCook 10 min

Shaved ice, or "shave ice" as it's known in Hawaii, is a beloved tropical treat, perfect for cooling down during a warm holiday celebration. For a Tiki Christmas at Pearl Harbor, this vibrant dessert combines the refreshing island staple with festive red (strawberry) and green (lime) syrups, offering a delightful and colorful way to celebrate the season with a tropical twist.

Ingredients

  • 8 cups (about 1.9 L) ice cubes, or enough to fill your shaved ice machine
  • 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar
  • 1/2 cup (120ml) water
  • 1/2 teaspoon strawberry extract
  • 5-8 drops red food coloring
  • 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar
  • 1/2 cup (120ml) water
  • 1/2 teaspoon lime extract
  • 5-8 drops green food coloring
  • 1/4 cup (60ml) sweetened condensed milk (optional)

Method

  1. Prepare Red Strawberry Syrup: In a small saucepan, combine 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar and 1/2 cup (120ml) water. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar is completely dissolved and the mixture just begins to simmer. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Stir in the strawberry extract and red food coloring until the desired vibrant red color is achieved. Pour into a squeeze bottle or jar and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, at least 30 minutes.
  2. Prepare Green Lime Syrup: In a separate small saucepan, combine 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar and 1/2 cup (120ml) water. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar is completely dissolved and the mixture just begins to simmer. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Stir in the lime extract and green food coloring until the desired vibrant green color is achieved. Pour into a squeeze bottle or jar and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, at least 30 minutes.
  3. Prepare Shaved Ice: If using a shaved ice machine, follow the manufacturer's instructions to shave the ice into fine, fluffy snow. If using a high-powered blender, add ice cubes and blend on high, pulsing and stirring as needed, until a fine, snow-like consistency is achieved. Work in batches if necessary to avoid overheating the blender.
  4. Assemble: Divide the shaved ice among individual serving bowls or paper cones, mounding it high.
  5. Serve: Generously drizzle the red strawberry syrup over one side of the ice and the green lime syrup over the other side. For an extra creamy touch, drizzle with sweetened condensed milk if desired. Serve immediately with spoons.

Tips

  • For the best texture, use a dedicated shaved ice machine; blenders can produce a coarser, more granular ice.
  • Experiment with other tropical extracts like pineapple or coconut for additional flavor options.
  • Keep syrups chilled for optimal refreshment, and consider serving with small spoons or chopsticks for easy eating.
